lead.claim_scope: solver discriminator first; no asymptotic or ECDLP speedup claim

stages.title: canonical IR and exhaustive toy oracle
inputs: all 18 affine F17 targets at m3 t3 c1
controls: canonical round trip and deterministic exporters
stages.result: 18/18 exact target-set matches; 6 SAT, 12 UNSAT, 6 models per implementation; no timing

stages.title: backend representation equivalence
stages.pass: all enumerable projected model sets equal; every model replays; every accepted UNSAT certificate verifies; mutations fail
stages.fail: block benchmarking and report backend/target mismatch

stages.title: disjoint scratch preflight and freeze
stages.sample: 24 scratch instances: 2 rungs x 3 classes x 4 instances
outputs: frozen field/curve cells and protocol-derived seeds

stages.title: held-out exact-enumeration/F4/CDCL/XOR/QF_FF tournament
stages.advance: all correctness gates; four natural rungs; corrected upper slope CI <= 0.85 on largest three; below F4 instructions on largest two common rungs outside A/A
stages.not_advance: corrected lower slope CI >= 0.95 for three consecutive rungs, or every SAT bundle censors before F4 on both largest common rungs

stages.title: complete relation collection and logarithm replay
stages.required_certificate: independent scalar replay of recovered logarithms

stages.title: family theorem
stages.output: proved family invariant and complete asymptotic cost model
